overview.about: The Corales Puntacana Championship is a PGA Tour stop on the Dominican Republic's Caribbean coast, played at the dramatic Corales course with holes running along cliffs and the sea. Its closing stretch, 'the Devil's Elbow', plays right beside the ocean.
overview.nextEvent: The next Corales Puntacana Championship is played at Corales Golf Course in Punta Cana. Wind off the Caribbean and the exposed clifftop finish make it a memorable and unpredictable test.
